# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 9 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 48 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 5 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text-primary, #f3f3f7);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--text-primary, #14151c);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f3f3f7;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-primary` | #f3f3f7 | #14151c | Titles and body text on bg-page and bg-card. |
| `--text-secondary` | #a6a8bb | #555869 | Meta lines, synopses, labels on bg-page and bg-card (7:1). |
| `--text-muted` | #8b8ea4 | #646778 | Captions and inactive nav icons; 4.9:1 on bg-card, small text OK. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg-page, #0d0e13);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg-page, #f5f6fa);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0d0e13;
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg-page` | #0d0e13 | #f5f6fa | App background behind every screen. |
| `--bg-surface` | #14151c | #ffffff | Bottom navigation bar and sticky headers. |
| `--bg-card` | #1b1c26 | #ffffff | Cards: episode cards, stat tiles, season rows, search field. |
| `--bg-raised` | #252635 | #eceef4 | Hover and pressed state of cards and rows; poster placeholder. |
| `--accent-text` | #d97aa9 | #660033 | Accent as text: stat values, links, 'Show more', counts, card toggles. Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens. |
| `--accent-subtle` | #3a1229 | #f7e3ee | Tinted ground for selected rows and the completed season row. Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens. |
| `--on-accent` | #ffffff | #ffffff | Text and icons on accent fills (13:1 white on burgundy). Points at the active accent palette (burgundy); switch palettes by repointing the accent tokens. |
| `--accent-mark` | #de4a6f | #660033 | Accent for marks drawn straight on the page: active nav icon, progress fill, chart bars. Points at the active palette's -mark tone. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | dark | light |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--accent-hover` | #7a003d | #4d0026 |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 26px/32px Poppins, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-screen-title);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `screen-title` | `.screen-title`, `--text-screen-title` | 26px / 32px | 600 | `sans` | One per screen: Stats, show title on detail. |
| `section-title` | `.section-title`, `--text-section-title` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `sans` | Section headers: Trending Movies, Cast, Episodes. |
| `stat-value` | `.stat-value`, `--text-stat-value` | 24px / 30px | 600 | `sans` | Big number in a stat tile, in accent-text. |
| `card-title` | `.card-title`, `--text-card-title` | 15px / 22px | 600 | `sans` | Poster titles, episode titles, row labels. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 21px | 400 | `sans` | Synopses and paragraphs. |
| `meta` | `.meta`, `--text-meta` | 12px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Year, rating, runtime, '4/9 watched' counts. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 11px / 14px | 500 | `sans` | Stat tile captions and nav labels. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Poppins, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to label, meta line gaps. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between rows and between grid tiles. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Card padding, gap between posters in a carousel. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Screen side padding. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between sections. |
